title: Frozen like Pompeii, Ujjain’s 42 twisted skeletons await answers

Modern methods like DNA analysis and radiocarbon dating could clarify the ancient community's identity.

content: a senior official says the president has held two meetings in recent weeks . he has said he is working on 'something much bigger' for the Middle East . the plan seeks to contain Tehran’s regional influence while expanding efforts to normalise relations between Israel and its neighbours .

title: 'Zero control of its border': Trump tears into Spain over Ceuta migrant crisis
content: the migrant crisis in the spanish enclave of Ceuta is a 'ruined country' . he said the country could become a country with ZERO control of its border . his remarks follow a mass influx of migrants from Morocco into ceutaba .

title: 'Highly useful' but no breakthrough: What was discussed in Putin-US talks on Ukraine
content: envoys Steve Witkoff, jared Kushner and yuri Ushakov attend the talks at the Senate Palace of the Kremlin in Moscow . the meeting ended without any reported breakthrough on a Ukraine peace deal . ushakov said the meeting was substantive, constructive and extremely frank .

title: Egyptian TV presenter Sarah Khalifa among 12 sentenced to death in drugs case
content: 12 people, including tv presenter Sarah Khalifa, have been sentenced to death . they were part of a gang that imported ingredients used to manufacture drugs for sale . the defendants were also found in possession of illegal firearms and ammunition .

title: Iran planning ‘multi-front’ attack on Israel with Hezbollah, Hamas, Houthis: Report
content: the plan under consideration is intended to enable several fronts to operate against Israel at the same time, making a multi-front campaign part of the strategy from the outset . a report published last month said the IDF identified renewed coordination between Hamas and Hezbollah with Iranian assistance .

title: ‘Adjectives keep changing’: Kharge attacks PM Modi over ‘Naraz Fufa’ jibe at Cong
content: a speech at the SRCC was an opportunity to engage with the country's youth . but instead of facing questions from the youth, the speech turned into a political campaign . he also called it his "modus operandi" to hide his own failures .

title: With bare hands, lone warrior 'Bittu Tabahi' cleans up dumpyard of a river
content: a 21-year-old BSc student has been a solitary warrior against civic mess and pollution in his hometown . his online followers know him as 'Bittu Tabahi', meaning destruction . he picked up plastic bottles, tangled weeds and other solid waste from ajnar river .

title: India backs UN world map resolution but calls out inaccurate J&K depiction
content: the mea said the resolution neither adopts nor authenticates any particular world map and does not address political cartography . the measure does not endorse any particular map and that India’s sovereign territory must be depicted according to its official map .

title: 'Permanently disabled': US shares video of strike on Iranian tanker, issues warning
content: CENTCOM releases video of tanker engulfed in flames before sinking in the Gulf of Oman . it warned that any attack on US warships would invite a higher economic cost . the tanker was one of three Iranian crude oil carriers targeted by US forces .

title: 'Students tormented by BJP': Rahul backs MPSC paper leak protests in Maharashtra
content: opposition leader says "every student is tormented by the BJP regime" he urges the government to listen to the students and act immediately . he warns of alleged irregularities in the examinations of the public service commission .
